question: What has to happen to someone's access when they leave the organization?
answer_lines: When an individual leaves the organization (i.e., upon termination of employment), the following actions must occur regarding their access:
a. Disable system access within an organization-defined time period;
b. Terminate or revoke any authenticators and credentials associated with the individual;
c. Conduct exit interviews that include a discussion of organization-defined information security topics;
d. Retrieve all security-related organizational system-related property; and
e. Retain access to organizational information and systems formerly controlled by the terminated individual [PS-4].
